name: Kirkland Signature Wild Alaskan Sockeye Salmon Filets (Frozen)
whyItWorks: Individually vacuum-sealed wild sockeye salmon portions provide premium EPA and DHA omega-3 fatty acids, proven to exert anti-inflammatory effects on the intestinal mucosa. Bakes up moist, tender, and easily absorbed.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Thaw in refrigerator. Bake or pan-sear with a drizzle of olive oil and sea salt. Pair with steamed white jasmine rice.
